title: UneceAssessment
description:
The evaluation of an object, such as a product, process, or organization, with respect to the object's worth or
condition.

applicableStandard.description: A referenced standard applicable to this specified assessment.

applicableSustainabilityCharacteristic.description: A sustainability characteristic applicable to this specified assessment.

assessedObject.description: An object assessed for this specified assessment.

assessorParty.description: The assessor party for this specified assessment.

associatedBinaryFile.description: A binary file associated with this specified assessment.

assuranceLevelCode.description: The code specifying the assurance level, such as verified by second party or third party, for this specified assessment.

categoryCode.description: The code specifying the category for this specified assessment.

endDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the end of this specified assessment.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this specified assessment.

relatedTradeTransaction.description: A supply chain trade transaction related to this specified assessment.

reportDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value of the report of this specified assessment.

reportId.description: The report identifier for this specified assessment.

selfAssessedIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this specified assessment is self assessed.

startDateTime.description: The date, time, date time or other date time value for the start of this specified assessment.

statusCode.description: The code specifying the status of this specified assessment.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of specified assessment.

verifiedIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this specified assessment is verified.

verifierParty.description: A verifier party for this specified assessment.
